notes: Example cluster engine registry. A maintainer ships this file at a shared path and exports SLAB_ENGINES from a module file; workflow code then addresses engines by these names on any cluster that declares them. Entries execute as the calling user — trusting this file is trusting the cluster's module farm.

mace-mp.description: MACE-MP served from the cluster's rootstock install (worker in a pre-built env)

uma.description: FAIRChem UMA via rootstock; task= baked in for materials

lammps-delta.description: LAMMPS with this cluster's launcher baked in; pair_style etc. passed per call in calculator_options. Plain engine='lammps' is a slab built-in (and registry entries may not shadow it) — declare a distinct alias like this one to pin a curated site setup.

qe-delta.description: Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x with this cluster's command and pseudo_dir baked in, through slab's own factory (all the built-in engine's guards; env-mediated ASE config is refused — ASE parses that file at import time). Plain engine='qe' is a slab built-in (and registry entries may not shadow it) — declare a distinct alias like this one to pin a curated site setup.

vasp.description: VASP (licensed; binary available to authorized groups only)
